{
  "module": "timer_irq",
  "language": "Verilog-2001",
  "ports": [
    {"name": "clk", "direction": "input", "width": 1},
    {"name": "rst_n", "direction": "input", "width": 1, "reset": "async_active_low"},
    {"name": "enable", "direction": "input", "width": 1},
    {"name": "clear_irq", "direction": "input", "width": 1},
    {"name": "period", "direction": "input", "width": 16},
    {"name": "irq", "direction": "output", "type": "reg", "width": 1},
    {"name": "count", "direction": "output", "type": "reg", "width": 16}
  ],
  "behavior": {
    "reset": "count=0 and irq=0",
    "mode": "periodic timer",
    "counting": "when enable=1 and period!=0, count increments each cycle until count == period-1",
    "irq": "when count == period-1, irq is set to 1 and count wraps to 0",
    "clear_irq": "clear_irq=1 clears irq to 0 without stopping the counter",
    "disabled": "when enable=0, count holds its value and irq can still be cleared",
    "period_zero": "if period==0, counter holds at 0 and irq stays 0 except reset/clear behavior"
  },
  "constraints": [
    "synthesizable only",
    "no SystemVerilog",
    "nonblocking assignments in sequential logic",
    "no inferred latches"
  ]
}
